title: A Deployment, field by field
summary: A Deployment with a readiness probe, resource requests, settings from a ConfigMap and a scratch volume. Fill in the field names: the place of each one in the manifest is what you are learning.

apiVersion.note: The API group and version of a Deployment.
apiVersion.clue: The API group and version string used by a Deployment

selector.note: Which Pods the Deployment owns. It must match the template's labels, and can't be changed later.
selector.clue: Field at Deployment spec level whose matchLabels determine which Pods it manages

containerPort.note: The port the container listens on. Informational: leaving it out doesn't stop traffic.
containerPort.clue: Field inside a container’s ports list that declares its listening port number

envFrom.note: Turns every key of a ConfigMap into an environment variable at once.
envFrom.clue: Container field that imports keys from a referenced ConfigMap as environment variables

readinessProbe.note: Decides whether the Pod receives Service traffic. Failing it never restarts the container.
readinessProbe.clue: Container health-check field whose failure stops Service traffic without restarting the container

initialDelaySeconds.note: How long after the container starts before the first probe.
initialDelaySeconds.clue: Probe field specifying how long to wait after the container starts before checks begin

requests.note: What the scheduler reserves for the container on a node.
requests.clue: Child of resources containing the CPU and memory amounts used for scheduling

volumeMounts.note: Which of the Pod's volumes the container uses, and where.
volumeMounts.clue: Container field listing which named storage sources to attach and where

mountPath.note: The path inside the container where the volume appears.
mountPath.clue: Field on one storage attachment giving its absolute location inside the container

volumes.note: The Pod's volumes, declared once at Pod level, beside containers.
volumes.clue: Pod-spec field listing storage sources available to its containers

emptyDir.note: A scratch volume that starts empty and lives as long as the Pod.
emptyDir.clue: Volume source type for initially empty temporary storage deleted when the Pod is removed
